verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's first-party billing docs cover budgets that track actual against planned spend, budget notifications, and programmatic responses through Pub/Sub and the Billing API, which handles the budgets and alerts parts of the story. Nothing in the pack documents anomaly detection on spend, and nothing shows the controls are on or easy to set up from day one. Missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, evidence of day-one default configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration that budget alerts prevent surprise bills.

support.subject: As a founder, the bill cannot silently explode — budgets, alerts, and documented anomaly detection on spend, configurable from day one

citations.quote: Google Cloud -Kunden können Kosten mit Budgets und Budgetbenachrichtigungen planen, beobachten und kontrollieren.
